summary.text: Robert E. Craven Jr. is the Democratic candidate for the Rhode Island House of Representatives, District 32, and an attorney and professor from North Kingstown.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has served for the past four years as Director of Policy and Intergovernmental Affairs for the Rhode Island General Treasurer.

paragraphs.text: Robert E. Craven Jr. graduated from North Kingstown High School, earned a bachelor's degree from George Washington University in 2016, and received a law degree from the Villanova University School of Law in 2019.
His career experience includes working as an attorney and professor.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a third-generation resident of North Kingstown.
Craven defeated Kevin Hoyle in the Democratic primary for District 32 on September 9, 2026.

In the survey, he listed three campaign messages: supporting housing policies that let seniors and people just starting out stay in town, making health care and child care accessible and affordable, and investing in climate resilience, storm preparedness and environmental protection.
